name: Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP)
definition: A greedy algorithm for sparse coding that selects dictionary atoms sequentially to find an approximate sparse solution x for the problem min ||x||_0 subject to ||y - Dx||_2 <= epsilon.
summary: Orthogonal Matching Pursuit is a greedy sparse coding algorithm that iteratively selects dictionary atoms and uses orthogonal projection to ensure faster convergence and better orthogonality than standard Matching Pursuit.
